question: Who was the first Indian Army officer to be promoted to the rank of field marshal?
solution:
The Correct Answer is Sam Manekshaw.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sam Manekshaw is the first Indian Army officer to be promoted to the five-star rank of field marshal. 
 
• He was conferred with the rank of field marshal on 1 January 1973.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• The government of India conferred the rank of field marshal on K M Cariappa on 28 April 1986. 
 
• He was the first Indian Commander-in-Chief (C-in-C) of the Indian Army(Army Chief).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• During the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw was the Indian Army Commander-in-Chief.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan, India's second and third highest civilian honors, were given to him.
